subject.title: feat(googlechat): opt-in dmThreadMode to thread DM replies

question: Should Google Chat DM threading be exposed as a separate `dmThreadMode` account key, folded into the existing `replyToMode` model, or consolidated with the broader `threadSessions` direction?
rationale: This is a new public config surface in a message-delivery path that previously failed against real Google Chat DMs; automation can fix metadata, but it cannot choose the long-term product API or accept the live-service risk.

options.title: Choose the threading API first
options.body: Pause merge until maintainers decide whether `dmThreadMode`, `replyToMode`, or `threadSessions` owns DM threading semantics, then update this branch to that chosen contract.

options.title: Accept `dmThreadMode` as separate
options.body: Keep this PR's API shape, but require the exported type, generated metadata, docs/help, and redacted real Google Chat proof before merge.

options.title: Consolidate with threadSessions
options.body: Close or pause this narrower PR if the broader open Google Chat DM-thread-session work is the intended canonical direction.

recommendation.title: Choose the threading API first
recommendation.body: Pause merge until maintainers decide whether `dmThreadMode`, `replyToMode`, or `threadSessions` owns DM threading semantics, then update this branch to that chosen contract.

likelyOwner.reason: History shows this person merged and verified the prior DM thread-suppression fix and landed earlier Google Chat thread support.
